description: USRobotics Sportster ANSI BBS theme. Four runtime-selected models. Exact accent colours required when truecolour supported.
active_model_source: AT*MODEL (existing state/service; argument and output syntax unknown)

typography.family: monospace; prefer IBM VGA / CP437-inspired licensed font when available; fallback to ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace
typography.style: fixed character-cell widths, mostly single weight; ANSI block decoration for header
typography.text_case: use uppercase for section headers and key hints; title case for menu items

canonical_compact.requirements: No auto-wrap or scrolling; every visible row exactly <= 80 display cells; every screen exactly 25 visible rows

wide.mode: two-column framed cards and richer Phonebook split view

intermediate.mode: compact or reduced-column layout chosen by measured cells; never use 120-column layout blindly

terminal.below_80x25: Use safe clipped/scrollable minimal view with explicit short-terminal notice. Never overflow or promise full fidelity.
terminal.color: Use ANSI 24-bit RGB when supported, 256/16-colour approximation otherwise; monochrome must remain legible
terminal.glyph: Use box-drawing and block glyphs if terminal supports single-cell widths, else ASCII +-| fallback
terminal.safe_rightmost_column: Never print a newline after the final cell if it would cause terminal scrolling; render through existing terminal API.

web_mockup.scanlines: subtle decorative layer only; disable for reduced motion and accessible modes
